acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: An extended family, and eight fights.

acts.label: Fight #1
acts.desc: Luka’s parents – Nadia and Karen – try to figure out where to take him once war breaks out.
acts.title: Where Does Luka Go?

acts.label: Fight #2
acts.desc: Nadia and Karen have been arguing over Russian-ness since they needed to pick a school for Luka.
acts.title: Who Is Russian? And Who Is Ukrainian?

acts.label: Fights #3 and #4
acts.desc: Nadia remembers the times that Luka’s father would suggest going to Crimea for vacation, as if it wasn’t Ukrainian land occupied by Russia. And she remembers a present that Karen once gave Luka––the sort which had to be smuggled into the country.
acts.title: Crimea and the Globe

acts.label: Fight #5
acts.desc: Nadia tells the story of her father, Alex, who lives near Bucha, and how differently he and she view the Russian atrocities there.
acts.title: Bucha

acts.label: Fight #6
acts.desc: Nadia tells the story of her mother, who lives in Russia, and how she won’t do the one thing Nadia keeps asking her to do.
acts.title: About Giving Money to the Russian Government

acts.label: Fight #7
acts.desc: Karen sends Nadia a photo which drives them to a final showdown.
acts.title: The Nice Showdown

acts.label: Fight #8
acts.desc: Nadia’s step-father works for the Russian government. How to manage that?
acts.title: The Fight That Wasn’t

acts.label: Epilogue
acts.desc: Nadia and Karen’s son, Luka, who most of these fights are about, gets the last word.
acts.credits: Produced by Valerie Kipnis, Andrey Borzenko, and Lika Kremer
